captions.detailed: A multi-arm tree floor lamp featuring a thick, flat circular black base, a tall wooden central post, and five independent branch arms. Each arm is composed of a wooden curved branch stemming from a black collar on the central post. The arms end in white conical lamp shades that can tilt. Each arm rotates horizontally around the central post via a revolute joint at its collar, while each shade tilts vertically at the arm tip.
captions.instruction: Generate a multi-arm tree floor lamp with a black circular base and a tall wooden post. Attach five independent curved wooden branch arms with black collars that can rotate around the post, and cap each arm with a white conical lamp shade that can tilt at its tip.
captions.factory: Construct a base part using a flat cylinder and a tall post part using a vertical cylinder. For each of the five arms, define a collar using a box with a central cylindrical cutout, a curved arm sweep, and a conical shade. Set up revolute joints with a vertical axis (0, 0, 1) between the post and each collar to allow rotation, and add revolute tilt joints at the end of each arm to attach the conical shades.
